description: Registry of documented disaster-loss data sources (candidates and integrations) for Talaix. Tracks which loss datasets are reviewed, their access conditions and their integration status. No loss figures are stored here unless a source is integrated with a stated method and licence.
separation_note: Observed, estimated, modelled and projected loss figures are strictly separated categories. A figure may appear only in the category its source documents, with the source's method stated; categories are never merged into a single number.
no_figures_note: No documented loss figures exist in integrated sources as of this registry version; observed_events is deliberately empty.

sources.name: EM-DAT International Disaster Database
sources.provider: Centre for Research on the Epidemiology of Disasters (CRED), UCLouvain
sources.license_note: Free for non-commercial research use after registration; redistribution restricted — check EM-DAT terms before integration.
sources.coverage: Global disaster events with documented human and economic loss figures
sources.status_note: URL verified reachable (HTTP 200, 2026-08-17). Registration flow not yet completed; not integrated.

sources.name: DesInventar national disaster loss databases
sources.provider: UNDRR (United Nations Office for Disaster Risk Reduction)
sources.license_note: Open access downloads of national loss databases; per-country data maintained by national authorities — verify per-country terms.
sources.coverage: National and sub-national disaster loss inventories (variable country coverage)
sources.temporal_coverage: Varies by country; multi-decadal for several national databases
sources.granularity: event level, sub-national (municipal/provincial) for many countries
sources.status_note: URL verified reachable (HTTP 200, 2026-08-17). Country coverage and formats not yet assessed; not integrated.

sources.name: UNDRR disaster risk reduction knowledge base
sources.provider: UNDRR (United Nations Office for Disaster Risk Reduction)
sources.license_note: Publications and statistics openly published; check per-dataset terms.
sources.coverage: Global DRR statistics, reports and loss-related publications (incl. GAR reports)
sources.granularity: aggregated statistics and reports, not event-level records
sources.status_note: URL verified reachable (HTTP 200, 2026-08-17). Entry point to DesInventar and GAR loss analyses; not integrated.

sources.name: World Bank Open Data
sources.license_note: Open data under CC-BY-4.0 for most indicators; attribution required.
sources.coverage: Global development indicators incl. disaster-related economic indicators
sources.status_note: URL verified reachable (HTTP 200, 2026-08-17). Relevant disaster-loss indicators not yet selected; not integrated.

sources.name: GFDRR (Global Facility for Disaster Reduction and Recovery)
sources.license_note: Publications and tools openly published; check per-resource terms.
sources.coverage: Disaster risk assessments, post-disaster needs assessments (PDNA/DaLA) and risk-finance resources
sources.granularity: assessment reports and country profiles, not a unified event-loss database
sources.status_note: URL verified reachable; returns HTTP 403 to scripted clients (bot protection) — domain confirmed live (2026-08-17). Not integrated.

sources.name: NOAA Billion-Dollar Weather and Climate Disasters
sources.provider: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information (NCEI)
sources.license_note: US government public data; cite NCEI as source.
sources.coverage: United States only — weather and climate disasters with losses >= 1 billion USD (CPI-adjusted)
sources.status_note: URL verified reachable (HTTP 200, 2026-08-17). US-only coverage — must never be presented as global; not integrated.

sources.name: Munich Re NatCatSERVICE
sources.license_note: Commercial licence; figures quoted in Munich Re publications are copyrighted — do not redistribute without licence.
sources.coverage: Global natural-catastrophe loss database (insured and overall losses)
sources.status_note: URL verified reachable (HTTP 200, 2026-08-17). Commercial product; no licence in place; not integrated.

sources.name: Swiss Re sigma
sources.license_note: sigma reports publicly downloadable after registration; underlying catastrophe database commercial — verify terms.
sources.coverage: Global natural-catastrophe and man-made loss statistics (insured and overall losses)
sources.granularity: event level within reports; annual aggregates
sources.status_note: URL verified reachable; returns HTTP 403 to scripted clients (bot protection) — domain confirmed live (2026-08-17). Not integrated.
